meta.name: lark-vc
meta.description: 飞书视频会议：搜索历史会议记录、查询会议纪要（总结/待办/章节/逐字稿）、查询参会人快照。当用户查询已结束的会议、获取会议产物（纪要/妙记）、查看参会人时使用；查询未来日程走 lark-calendar。不负责：Agent 真实入会/离会、会中实时事件（走 lark-vc-agent）。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史会议记录和查询会议纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要回顾飞书会议记录和纪要
copy.tagline_en: Search past meeting records and query meeting notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review Lark meeting records and notes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以搜索已结束的飞书会议、查看会议纪要（总结、待办、章节、逐字稿）和参会人快照。
howto.when: 当你询问已结束的会议记录、会议纪要或参会人时触发。查询未来日程请用 lark-calendar。

say.text: 帮我查一下上周的站会纪要。
say.note: Claude 会搜索上周的站会并返回纪要链接或内容。

say.text: 昨天下午的会议有哪些人参加了？
say.note: Claude 会查询该会议的参会人快照。

say.text: 把上周产品评审会的待办事项列出来。
say.note: Claude 会读取会议纪要中的待办列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search for ended Lark meetings, view meeting notes (summary, todos, chapters, verbatim), and query participant snapshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about ended meeting records, meeting notes, or participants. For future schedules, use lark-calendar.

say_en.text: Find the notes from last week's standup meeting.
say_en.note: Claude will search for the meeting and return note links or content.
Claude will query the participant snapshot for that meeting.

say_en.text: List the action items from last week's product review.
say_en.note: Claude will read the todos from the meeting notes.
